_note: Curated standing pickup games around Burlington. Every entry needs a source link that states the schedule; door is what the organizer says, not our guess. Approved reader suggestions are served live by wp_pickup and merged on the client — this file is the verified core. last_checked is the date the link was last read. season is warm (Apr–Sep), cold (Oct–Mar) or all; out-of-season entries sink to the bottom, never hide.

entries.name: Sunday Basketball (18+)
entries.schedule: Sundays 10:00 AM – 12:30 PM. Off during school vacations.
entries.note: South Burlington Rec & Parks. 18+, first-timers sign a waiver, no spectators.

entries.name: Men's Friday Basketball (35+)
entries.schedule: Fridays 6:30 – 8:30 PM. Off during school vacations.
entries.note: South Burlington Rec & Parks. Men 35+, waiver required, no spectators.

entries.name: Adult Drop-In Basketball (18+)
entries.schedule: Weekly; recent sessions were Saturday and Sunday 8:00 – 10:00 PM. Times move — check the city calendar.
entries.note: Burlington Parks, Recreation & Waterfront.

entries.name: Monday Indoor Soccer (Futsal)
entries.schedule: Mondays 6:00 – 8:00 PM, winter season. Off during school vacations.
entries.note: South Burlington Rec & Parks. Co-ed, 18+, all abilities, waiver required.

entries.name: Recreational Pickup Soccer (7v7)
entries.schedule: Sundays 7:00 – 8:30 AM.
entries.note: Social Sports VT. 16+, all levels — register online ahead of time, it isn't walk-up.

entries.name: Mixed Pickup Ultimate
entries.venue: Field announced weekly by Vermont Ultimate
entries.schedule: Thursdays, all summer.
entries.note: Vermont Ultimate. Check their site for this week's field.

entries.name: Women & Nonbinary Pickup Ultimate
entries.venue: Field announced weekly by Vermont Ultimate
entries.schedule: Wednesdays, all summer.
entries.note: Vermont Ultimate. Check their site for this week's field.

entries.name: Indoor Volleyball Drop-In
entries.schedule: Saturdays 4:30 – 6:30 PM, fall through spring.
entries.note: Jacked Sports & Social Club. Join through their Meetup group or email first.

entries.name: Public Skate at Leddy Arena
entries.venue: Gordon H. Paquette Ice Arena, Leddy Park
entries.schedule: Posted monthly on the city calendar; recent sessions were Wednesday 9:00 – 10:30 AM and Sunday 2:30 – 4:00 PM.
entries.note: Burlington Parks, Recreation & Waterfront. Times shift around rink bookings — check the current month.

entries.name: Outdoor Pickleball at Leddy Park
entries.schedule: No set session — four free lit courts, first come first served.
entries.note: City courts, lines over the tennis courts. Busy evenings and weekends.

entries.name: Monday Pickleball (18+)
entries.schedule: Mondays 6:00 – 8:30 PM. Off during school vacations.
entries.note: South Burlington Rec & Parks. Loaner paddles for newcomers. May be limited to South Burlington residents — confirm first.

entries.name: Indoor Drop-In Pickleball, by level
entries.schedule: Several sessions a week by level — e.g. Intermediate Mon/Tue/Fri 1:00 – 3:00 PM, plus Beginner, High Intermediate, Advanced.
entries.note: Burlington Parks, Recreation & Waterfront. The level/day grid rotates — check the calendar.

entries.name: Adult Drop-In Table Tennis
entries.schedule: Mondays 6:00 – 8:30 PM.
entries.note: Burlington Parks, Recreation & Waterfront. Three tables.

entries.name: Squash / Racquetball / Handball Round Robin
entries.venue: The EDGE at West Twin Oaks
entries.schedule: Weekly round robin plus drop-in times; the day and hour are on the in-club schedule.
entries.note: The EDGE Sports & Fitness. No registration for round robins — check in at the front desk. Call (802) 860-3343 for the current time.

entries.name: GMBC Wednesday Training Ride
entries.schedule: Wednesdays, rolling at 6:00 PM (Apr – Aug) or 5:30 PM (Sep – Oct). About 28 miles.
entries.note: Green Mountain Bicycle Club. Groups of 12 or fewer self-sort by pace; membership not required.

entries.name: GMAA Tuesday Group Run
entries.schedule: Tuesdays 5:45 PM, about 6 miles on the bike path and nearby streets.
entries.note: Green Mountain Athletic Association. Listed as a member group run — confirm the guest policy with the organizer first.

entries.name: GMAA Thursday Track Workout
entries.schedule: Thursdays 5:45 PM in summer; winter varies. All paces.
entries.note: Green Mountain Athletic Association, coached. Check the current season's schedule.

entries.name: Skirack High Five Run
entries.schedule: Thursdays, 5 – 6 miles. Call for the start time.
entries.note: Listed on Vermont Running Company's group-runs page.

entries.name: Outdoor Gear Exchange Fun Run
entries.schedule: Wednesdays, 5 – 6 miles. Call for the start time.
entries.note: Listed on Vermont Running Company's group-runs page.

entries.name: CRAG-VT Community Climbs
entries.venue: Rotates: Petra Cliffs, MetroRock, BurlyBloc, outdoor crags
entries.schedule: Monthly, 5:30 – 8:00 PM. Upcoming: Oct 15 BurlyBloc, Nov 19 MetroRock, Dec 17 Petra Cliffs.
entries.note: Climbing Resource Access Group of Vermont. Open to any member; you can join at the door. Not guided — bring your own gear and partner.
